reviewPurpose: Semantically verify that every field of the canonical OVERVIEW row for TM108 is covered by dft-meta.json and dft-conditions.yaml, and that each derived testCondition field is explained by a source locator.
rule: Read the single OVERVIEW row of Dali_testmode.xlsx (plaintext sha256 896770d29f8ae58852e1031c1e6210c5435e52df38e0f6a0fb8fc1836622c04b) and compare rawIntent with testCondition field by field. A source contradiction is preserved as an open item and reported, never resolved. No value may be inferred, no source substituted, no hash re-bound.
